cells: A new external recipient confirms and submits without donor/missionary/staff membership or unrelated access; an existing legitimate account retains its actual affiliations.
Forwarded invitation alone, unrelated signed-in account, stale verified-email claim, wrong recipient revision, another tenant and another request disclose no protected facts and admit no action.

Qualified current proof reuses safely; unqualified proof triggers the correct confirmation. No repeated email per chunk/range/page load. Same-mailbox shared/represented scenarios never claim unproved individual identity.

Safe link and secondary code redeem the same confirmation issuance once. GET/HEAD and passive scanner visits establish no authority or sends; stripped fragments fail safely. Advanced scripted form submission is tested without claiming an exchange proves human identity. Explicit correct POST still requires proof/current source admission; legitimate OAuth callbacks retain their different protocol.

Real database roles cannot alter authority columns, reparent within/across tenant, mark clean/accepted, call service-only functions or read counts/metadata outside scope. Test effective grants/RLS and privileged worker boundary separately.
Verify versus revoke, recipient correction, credential change, request revision and expiry races have one authoritative winner. A→B→A address changes do not revive historical proof.

Same operation retried after lost response returns/reconciles the accepted outcome; same key with different intent conflicts. Concurrent code/link/redemption/upload finalization has no duplicate business effect.

Email provider accepted/response lost, queue outage, native-hook timeout, delayed callback, failed resend and suppressed destination retain honest status and governed recovery without fresh-key duplicate send.
Forged completion/type/size/digest, wrong key, overwrite, expired upload grant, late processor and cleanup/promotion races cannot expose or accept unqualified bytes.
Instructions, filename, preview, original, history, duplicates, search/count, HEAD/range/conditional, errors and result recovery each enforce their exact current action permission.

Codes/verifiers/private content are absent from ordinary URL paths/queries, logs, traces, referrers, email tracking, ordinary audit/history, queues, durable browser storage and exported diagnostics. The sole qualified transient verifier fragment is promptly scrubbed per the inherited doorway; test history after scrubbing and its documented external limits. Actual CDN responses retain required private headers.
Wrong account, inaccessible inbox, legitimate alias, correction, expiry and shared-device use have safe recovery; no staff verified toggle or claimant-selected replacement mailbox.

Actual keyboard, whole-code paste/autofill, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, RTL/Unicode, mobile email switching, delayed mail and poor-network participants complete the permitted task with understandable state. Test safe-link and code alternatives.

Old/new code and schema overlap cannot grant donor/default-tenant access or accept unknown proof/context versions. Deny switch/rollback preserves revocations, accepted evidence and existing valid accounts.
Restore/replay does not resurrect ended grants, obsolete recipient bindings or previously disposed eligibility. Auth evidence and document-byte retention stay independently governed.

Native request works with full Workflow Studio/applications absent after its exact shared sources qualify. Existing receipt, giving, collaboration and newsletter flows preserve their accepted behavior.

Shaped concurrency proves finite request/tenant/global send and byte/processing budgets, fair recovery, acceptable latency and no resource exhaustion fallback. Limits include units, windows, start event, boundary tests and owner; vendor examples are not measured Core capacity.

A bounded actual staff/participant pilot records completion, steps, mail delay, retries and recovery. Before expansion, every safety-critical misunderstanding and supported-path dead end is resolved. Small qualitative pilot results are not presented as statistically proven conversion improvement.
Confirmed currently authorized recipient returns after reload/lost response and sees the exact durably received submission/status without resubmitting or creating another effect.
Deliberate View opens the supported qualified rendition of that exact version. Local selection preview, same filename, mutable path or generic latest pointer cannot substitute.
Wrong principal/recipient/request/tenant, same email/hash, changed recipient and unauthorized staff cannot discover metadata, counts or bytes; Q01 proof does not itself grant read.
Current restrictions apply to thumbnails/pages/tiles/grids, HEAD/full/range/conditional responses, back/forward/reconnect and cached results. Wrong-scope 304 or late response cannot restore data.
Received-but-processing, unsupported, unsafe, failed and limited states remain truthful; none auto-downloads originals, exposes provider URLs or sends bytes to another viewer/service.
Actual bounded PDF/Office/text/image profiles withstand harmless hostile fixtures without scripts/macros/formulas, external fetch, credentials, host access or cross-tenant scratch leakage.

Coverage/values are accurate for saved sheets, missing formula cache, hidden content, comments/revisions, animation, encoding and dates; unknown/incomplete output never claims whole-document fidelity.
Actual represented content and controls work with keyboard, AT, mobile, RTL, zoom/reflow and poor network; native text remains available and content limitations have a qualified accessible path.
Concurrent opens coalesce without sharing permission. Same effect/key with different input conflicts; retry/lost response recovers the original outcome under current disclosure rights.
Replacement, source restriction, profile change, lease expiry and late callbacks cannot promote output for a different version/claim or resurrect ended authority.

Cleanup versus Ready promotion has one winner; stale cleanup cannot delete promoted outputs, deletion-claimed bytes cannot promote, immutable keys are not reused and partial provider success is reconciled.

Ending, revoking or expiring the authenticated participant session blocks reads under that ended admission while independently authorized source processing may finish. Closing a viewer/tab/browser alone is not represented as logout or revocation; actual source withdrawal applies its own fences.

Arbitrary root upload/free-text purpose cannot allocate durable custody. Exact source request, resource/media draft, generation or import staging can do so before active placement without fabricated records or full future products.
A file can have separately admitted uses without copying/mutating business identities, exposing all uses, merging retention or automatically widening audience.
Folder move/removal, unlink, no visible use, request closure and rendition expiry cannot delete source originals or override hold/retention; new-use/hold/disposition races remain guarded.
Real database roles, effective RLS/grants, views/functions, command and worker paths prevent authority-column changes and cross-purpose same-tenant reparenting; service-role tests alone do not pass.
Legacy public/mutable/unknown-origin data is reconciled without unsafe relabelling/deletion; mixed versions and disable/roll-forward preserve exact source history and deny weaker fallback.
Restore/provider exit recovers actual bytes, digests, source references and obligations; revoked/private/disposed eligibility remains suppressed before any delivery.
Inherited healthy/maximum/overload/skew budgets hold with measured worker capacity, fair tenant work and bounded retries; no quota pressure causes public access or false Ready.

A bounded staff/participant pilot distinguishes selected/received/previewable/accepted, checks the correct version and returns to the task. Resolve all safety-critical misunderstandings and supported-path dead ends before expansion; do not claim statistically proven time savings from a small pilot.
An eligible confirmed recipient can correct the exact pending item in its existing request without staff unlocking, retyping unchanged identity or entering a drive.
Accepted/frozen/closed/waived or otherwise ineligible target denies correction even while other request items remain open. Merely opening a preview changes no correction eligibility.
Forged tenant/principal/recipient/source/item/predecessor/status fields cannot disclose or mutate another scope; real participant roles, grants/RLS and privileged workers are tested separately.
Selection, picker cancel and definite pre-admission failure change no source review selection; deliberate admitted correction preserves bytes and alters only its exact target use.
Receipt admission immediately fences predecessor acceptance while the new candidate is still checking; a failed/unsafe new candidate does not silently revive it.
Acceptance-first and correction-first races each yield the rightful outcome; stale review cannot approve a successor or claim success after losing its revision guard.
Concurrent same-target corrections cannot create two current successors. Independent items can progress; real bundle dependencies remain fenced.
Correcting one file within a multi-file item preserves other members, other admitted uses, prior comments/decisions and accurate required/satisfied-item counts.

Same semantic operation retried after lost response/double click/reconnect returns the same result; changed content/target/revision with the same key conflicts. Replayed result requires current disclosure rights.

New bytes get fresh integrity/hygiene/profile qualification; prior clean status, filename or local preview cannot bypass it. Scanner outage and unsafe content have distinct safe recovery; an outage with intact received bytes recovers the same attempt rather than demanding another file.
Preview unavailable remains distinct from unsafe or unreceived; otherwise permitted correction still works. No implicit original download or third-party viewer fallback appears.
Deadline boundary, changed instructions, recipient change, revocation and session expiry are rechecked at the correct authority boundary; no automatic time extension or recipient substitution occurs.
Stop transfer/close UI racing with commit is truthful. Confirmed admission is not undone; confirmed pre-admission cancellation is not displayed as received; uncertainty is reconciled.
Provider success/DB failure, DB success/lost response and required event dispatch failure converge without duplicated effects, orphan promotion or erased evidence.
Late scan/preview/callback and cleanup cannot change a successor's state, revive source authority, delete promoted/referenced bytes or inherit old verdicts.

Recipient and reviewer view the exact appropriate version; a new correction does not replace content under active review, migrate notes or steal focus. Keyboard, speech input, screen reader, touch/non-drag, focus return, errors, status announcements and actual preview content work across the supported journey; automated checks are supplemented by manual proof.

Long/Unicode/RTL filenames, localization, zoom/reflow, mobile viewport, clear time zones and poor connectivity preserve task completion and exact source identity without private persistent device caching.
Ordinary telemetry/queues/errors contain no forbidden private values; history, duplicate hints, counts and old content reveal only currently authorized information.
Specialized expense/claim confirmation, application decisions, issued documents, signatures, resource/public-media publication and independent source uses remain unchanged by native correction.

New corrections create no automatic business acceptance, generic CRM interaction, unconditional email or duplicate task. Required authorized secondary effects recover exactly once at the durable business boundary.
Mixed-version rollout, legacy records, disable/roll-forward and actual byte restore preserve exact admitted history; stale writers and restored revoked rights remain blocked.

Exact inherited source/preview limits hold at boundary and one-unit excess; retries, history pagination, skewed tenants and overload remain bounded with fair processing and no weaker-security fallback.

A representative participant/reviewer pilot can identify the target, send a correction, distinguish received/checking/accepted, recover from interruption and review the right file without assistance-driven dead ends. Resolve every observed safety-critical misunderstanding before expansion; report the sample and limits rather than claiming statistical proof.
An ordinary eligible recipient finds and downloads the exact own submitted file in the request without staff unlocking, viewer entry or a drive.
Wrong tenant/recipient/principal/request/member, old assignment, same mailbox/hash and forbidden other-source use cannot obtain metadata, bytes or distinguishing error details.

Effective real-role grants/RLS, source predicates, reference constraints, functions/storage and privileged gateway paths enforce the same original-download boundary; caller-supplied authority fields fail.

The returned artifact is exactly the selected immutable received version, including a corrected submission. Trusted copy/version/length/digest binding exists before emission; metadata-to-read replacement is rejected. A post-transfer hash alone, generated summary, preview, first historical version and redaction cannot establish or substitute that identity.
Whole-original hidden content/metadata and permitted features receive their own source qualification. Preview clearance, business acceptance or uploader status cannot bypass a restriction.
Qualified original with unavailable preview remains deliberately downloadable; qualified preview with blocked original remains view-only. Failure of either cannot trigger the other automatically.

Pending checks, confirmed unsafe content, checker outage, revoked access, changed submission and missing/corrupt copy produce truthful distinct safe recovery without duplicate uploads or weak fallback.

Revocation, session/stream expiry and source restriction deny new/HEAD/range/conditional/recovery requests, enforce per-chunk expiry and exercise measured feasible in-flight termination. No realtime grace or recall claim.

Authorized ranges/conditional responses use exact lengths/validators/representation; malformed, excessive, overlap and unsatisfiable requests obey qualified limits without metadata leaks or amplification bypass.

Reconstructed resumed downloads match the same admitted byte identity. Partial ranges use a qualified immutable whole-object/version or chunk-integrity binding. Missing or changing provider copies fail rather than mixing versions or fabricating originals.
Actual route/proxy/CDN/browser/service-worker behavior preserves private delivery; extension-wide rules, alternate URLs, redirects and 304 responses cannot create public/cache authority.

Response media/disposition/no-sniff and safe Unicode filename handling work across supported browsers; controls, paths, bidi hazards and misleading extensions cannot inject headers or execute content in the app origin.

Before delivery begins, error/login/no-body failures produce safe non-attachment recovery and never masquerade as original bytes. Valid partial responses obey exact-range semantics. On truncation or mid-stream failure, terminate and report failure where observed; never append error/login/JSON/HTML or substitute bytes. Browsers may retain partial files. Provide safe exact-version retry/resume where qualified and a route back to the request; never claim complete saving or partial-file erasure.
Repeated deliberate reads and browser retries are authorized/metered/audited without creating new submission, acceptance, consent, communication or CRM effects.
Client/server resource use remains bounded under maximum admitted files, slow clients, disconnects, repeated ranges, concurrent tenants and any object-URL path; no eager whole-list downloads.
Link/control labels, file context, type/size and unavailable explanations work with keyboard, speech, screen readers, touch, zoom/reflow, long/RTL names and Core's shared visual system.
Native browser handling, user-declined saving, repeated clicks and device settings never produce false Saved/Read/Accepted claims. Any progress/handoff claim matches actual observation.
Page load, hover, framework prefetch, preview failure, auth return and background retry do not initiate an unintended original transfer or claim human intent.

The relevant tier's audit-before-serve/durable-outbox and budget behavior holds on every route, including injected missing audit client, returned insert error, thrown error and outbox failure. Read/cleanup/hold/disposition races preserve applicable source rules; no stale reader revives disposed eligibility or pins retention indefinitely. A download is not verified external custody.
Existing P18 official history, P21 evidence, P22 provenance, P26 restrictions and other source-qualified downloads retain their rules; Q04 creates no broader archive/audience.
Legacy URL containment, mixed-version rollout, kill switch/roll-forward and actual byte restore cannot bypass current source authority or lose identity/history.

A representative participant pilot identifies the intended file, distinguishes View/Download, understands browser handling and resolves common failures. Resolve safety-critical misunderstandings and supported-path dead ends before expansion; report sample limits rather than invented success rates.

Untouched older supporting members remain current and usable; only exact correction predecessors become earlier. Same filename/digest/time cannot merge or relabel source acts.

Receipt appears after authoritative admission of finalized bytes under current source authority, even while hygiene/preview checks remain pending. Failed/abandoned transfer and lost responses do not create false receipt or require unnecessary duplicate submission.
Duplicate/replayed/out-of-order projection delivery yields one source-correct history fact per business effect, preserving exact lineage under tied/backdated display times.
Current status/actions and displayed correction relationships are coherent or explicitly uncertain; an older read result cannot overwrite a newer relevant state.

Ordinary historical preview/thumbnail/OCR/snippet/original/HEAD/range/conditional/export routes and stale URLs deny superseded content; hiding a button alone cannot pass.

A failed correction or checker outage preserves truthful received history without reviving its predecessor or manufacturing acceptance.

Timezone/localization/clock ties/import provenance and actor wording remain accurate; You is never inferred from mailbox or present recipient alone. Later request/item label or instruction changes cannot reinterpret the admitted historical act.

Status updates announce only material change, preserve reading focus, do not repeat the entire history and never infer Saved/Read/Accepted from access.

The source-approved help path reaches its responsible responder with safe context and yields a truthful permitted outcome; it cannot automatically deliver old content or bypass independent evidence authority.

Source restriction, logout/account/tenant switch, stale responses and restored caches remove/reject unauthorized history through existing contracts; no cross-context or persistent private offline cache.

Maximum admitted page/response/query/concurrency budgets and one-unit excess behave safely. Under new corrections and permission changes, continuation preserves its declared coverage/current authorization without duplicate or silently skipped in-scope facts, hidden totals or an unsupported claim of complete live history.
Required access audit/metering is durable under its tier and privacy-safe; history reads create no duplicate receipt, notification, task, acknowledgement, acceptance or retention/session extension.
Omitted history and missing descriptors do not trigger deletion; holds/disposition/privacy suppression preserve owner obligations. Restore cannot resurrect denied visibility or old currentness.
Legacy partial data, mixed writers/readers, old links, kill switch/roll-forward and recovery are reconciled for each source cohort; no fabricated backfill or public/broader fallback.
Existing Q01 confirmation, Q02 preview, Q03 correction and Q04 exact current download behavior survive, including independent members and in-flight stream limits.

Representative participant/staff tasks show people understand current versus earlier, received versus accepted, recovery and help. Resolve critical misunderstanding/dead ends; document sample limits and unmet historical-content needs without invented prevalence.
A normally fulfilled ordinary request presents truthful completion, eligible current-file actions and concise history under current authority; ordinary submission/correction cannot continue.
Upload progress, clean scans, generic task flags, technical callbacks, canceled work and access loss cannot manufacture normal fulfillment or its completion evidence.

Correction-first forces completion to evaluate the admitted successor/relevant evidence set; completion-first rejects stale ordinary admission. Already admitted receipt/history survives, and hygiene/preview readiness does not delay Q03's fence.
Lost responses and duplicate/out-of-order completion events converge on one durable source outcome without duplicate notices, renewed grants, reset deadlines or new ordinary intake.
Later invalidation preserves historical completion and follows explicit linked source remediation; it cannot reopen predecessor work, silently substitute files or broaden recipients.

All UI/API/import/support/worker paths reject ungranted business mutations in completed mode, while specifically authorized read-support/help operations still work without altering evidence or clocks.
Missing/null/unresolvable or inconsistent access policy cannot permit unbounded completed reads; known valid policy is represented truthfully and associated with its source authority.
Immediately before, exactly at and after the effective end, server-authorized metadata/history/full/HEAD/range/conditional/recovery behavior is correct despite client skew or delayed cleanup.

Session/proof expiry permits only qualified re-entry while source access remains; login, link resend, repeated reads and help never revive an expired/revoked grant or reopen business work. Independently authorized source completion/reconciliation after participant expiry preserves its result without restoring participant access or disclosing protected status/history through that expired grant.
Wrong tenant/environment/principal/recipient revision/request/item/purpose, shared mailbox, reassignment and staff-role union cannot obtain the completed projection or content.
Actual grants/RLS/USING/new-row checks/views/functions/RPC/storage/service paths prevent forged completion, actor, source scope, expiry, clearance and ownership transitions.

Exact current members and independent supporting uses remain correct. Superseded content and newly introduced members are not exposed under old completed authority without explicit source qualification.
Preview expiry/failure, unsafe/restricted originals and missing copies produce independent truthful states; no automatic download, old-file fallback, moving version or unsupported success.
Long streams enforce inherited per-chunk expiry and feasible restriction termination; new resume/range requests reauthorize; buffering/partial-file limits are measured without recall claims.
Completed metadata/content is private through actual route/CDN/browser/service-worker/error/conditional behavior, logout/switch/back navigation and stale-response invalidation.
History-only failure leaves separately verified current work usable; unknown source authority/outcome remains safely unavailable rather than open, rejected, expired or fabricated complete.
Applicable access-end wording is accurate across timezone/locale and action-specific restrictions; later policy changes do not leave a misleading universal availability promise.
Actual keyboard/speech/AT/touch/mobile/zoom/RTL/long-name and low-bandwidth completion/re-entry/help journeys work, with stable focus and meaningful non-repeating status.

Each content-set timing limit has a documented applicable WCAG 2.2.1 mechanism/exception and tested outcome; security labels/reauthentication alone cannot pass. Any accommodation preserves explicit source authority.
The real source help path returns a truthful permitted outcome without automatic renewal, old-file release, new membership, source reopening or an unselected communication.

Tier-correct audit/metering and opaque diagnostics distinguish source completion, current grant decisions and transfer outcomes without private-content leakage or invented human-read/acceptance evidence.

Finite serving/processing/page/query/egress budgets hold at their boundaries and one-unit excess under slow clients, repeated returns, expired renditions and concurrent tenants; active work is not starved.
Legacy unknowns, mixed writers/readers, alternate URLs, kill switch/roll-forward, hold/disposition and restore preserve source evidence and deny resurrected access or intake.

Representative recipients understand completion, remaining permitted actions, session versus access expiry and the help path. Resolve safety-critical misunderstandings and dead ends; report sample limits and unmet needs, not invented satisfaction/support metrics.

Only prospectively admitted ordinary source profiles get this rule; specialist/legacy/independent rights remain unchanged. Fourteen-day and fixed-end alternatives are recorded as rejected options, not hidden configuration.

A trusted normal-fulfillment event produces exactly a 720-hour maximum. Rejected client/business/unknown/future timestamps cannot supply an anchor; date/month/year/DST boundaries preserve the selected elapsed meaning.

Completion immediately before, at and after an earlier source end has correct eligibility. After expiry/revocation or missing recipient admission, independently authorized source work can complete without recipient readback or a fabricated access grant. A delayed consumer proves the original relevant policy/eligibility/caps plus current authority, never today's state alone.

An earlier admitted end controls; later cap removal/default increase cannot lengthen it. A later genuine source-authority shortening remains binding after its cause is removed/relaxed, without restoring the prior later end. Clearing an explicitly temporary restriction restores only an eligible representation within unchanged valid authority.

Duplicate messages, concurrent completion attempts, lost response, replay, projection rebuild and delayed processing recover one durable source outcome/end and no duplicate required effects. A replay after caller expiry preserves the business result without leaking its stored private response.

Completion races correction admission, recipient reassignment and restriction with one authoritative relevant ordering. No stale predecessor certification, new audience or invalid late submission is admitted.
Missing/null/nonfinite/invalid policy, malformed provenance, unsupported precision and unknown legacy semantics deny affected access without fabricating expiry, completion or rejection.

At the actual declared precision, immediately before/at/after end checks behave correctly with cleanup paused, wrong client time, stale sessions, long transactions and qualified clock failure handling. No unselected grace appears.
Return, first view, login, proof refresh, resend, download retry, help, preview regeneration and delayed notice never slide/pause the source clock.
Same email/person/file across tenants, environments, requests and recipient revisions cannot cross scope, including direct identifiers, error differences, counts, search and pagination.

Every metadata/history, original/preview, HEAD/range/conditional/resume/recovery and alternate delivery path requires current authority; no old URL, latest pointer or technical worker result grants access.

Real user/recipient/staff/service roles, column grants, RLS USING/new-row checks, combined policies, views/RPCs/storage and privileged functions prevent scope/actor/anchor/end/clearance forgery and forbidden updates.

Same-scope FKs/typed references, effect uniqueness, required fields, valid state constraints and delete/hold behavior protect integrity while allowing truthful completed-without-recipient-access outcomes.

Original/preview eligibility and temporary recovery stay independent; superseded/new unrelated files remain inaccessible. Slow streams enforce per-chunk end and feasible termination; buffered/emitted limitations are measured without recall claims.

Actual route/CDN/browser/service-worker/cache/back-navigation/logout/switch behavior does not create a new protected read or cross-context disclosure after authority ends. Already received copies are treated honestly.
Actual earlier ends and precision display correctly across locale/timezone/DST changes, zoom and RTL. No date rendering or hydration change moves the server end or promises an extra interval.

Unknown authority, session/proof expiry, ended source access, file unavailability, history-only failure and partial/lost outcomes yield distinct truthful allowed states and preserve independent valid work.

Representative keyboard/speech/AT/touch/mobile/zoom/low-bandwidth journeys can find the end and actions, re-enter and recover focus. Each timing limit has documented applicable conformance proof; automated checks alone do not pass.
The actual governed help route works and gives a permitted outcome without enrollment/bypass/automatic extension/private attachment fallback or false promise.
Access expiry, retention, holds, disposal, independent source uses and previously saved copies remain separate; neither automated deletion nor retained-file access is inferred.

Provider failure, delayed/out-of-order callbacks, unknown external success and outage recovery preserve the original effect/end. No provider URL, lifetime, delivery retry or fresh rendition may authorize recipient serving beyond current Core permission; independently qualified processing/custody lifetimes remain separate.

Production-shaped tenant skew, repeated returns, concurrent streams and history sizes remain inside approved query/page/concurrency/egress budgets, including boundary and one-unit-excess cases; no global sweep is required to deny expired access.
Prospective cohort migration, mixed old/new readers/writers, rollback/roll-forward, backup restore and source fact correction preserve historical evidence and deny invented/revived access.
A scoped kill switch denies affected completed reads without reopening intake, deleting evidence or changing unrelated qualified rights. Re-enable requires current contracts and qualifications.

Representative recipients correctly understand actual cutoff, sign-in versus access expiry, unchanged source receipt and help. Identify cohorts with no usable completed readback under their binding limits before claiming delivery. Resolve safety-critical misunderstandings; report sample limits and validated unmet needs without invented support/satisfaction metrics.

Durable source/audit records and minimized diagnostic signals explain why an end/read changed without leaking private contents or falsely claiming human reading/saving/acceptance. Required controls have an assigned owner and tested response.
Only the explicitly adopted ordinary-expiry capability is available. B and unrelated specialist rights remain distinct; no implicit renewal, new portal, bulk action or notification appears.

Prove original ordinary admission/scope and actual expiry. Unknown admission, disposed/expired content, security revocation and genuine binding shortening cannot enter through a generic Expired status.

Issuer read access, staff role and ticket assignment alone cannot grant. Live exact administrative scope/ceiling, native context, assurance and applicable SoD/impersonation rules govern, including multi-role/self cases.

Issuance can be valid with the old grant expired and recipient offline, while every subsequent recipient read still requires qualified confirmation/current authority. Session/link/preview repair does not create a grant.

Later files, another recipient, superseded bytes, new purpose, resharing and unions of fresh scopes are rejected. A narrower prior fresh scope alone does not fabricate a global restriction.

Governed same-recipient contact recovery works without arbitrary retargeting. Same email/different principal, tenant or environment cannot inherit original scope; identity uncertainty denies appropriately.

Duplicate click, retry, lost response, delayed job and different transport IDs for one semantic intent converge on one effect/end. Same identity with changed subject/scope/policy payload conflicts without mutation.
Concurrent separate intentions atomically satisfy the adopted repeat/overlap policy. No reset, new operation ID or reordered event bypasses it; no unselected cardinality/default is silently assumed.

Source/P12 serialized mutation, exact scoped references, grant/effect/history/audit and authorized effect intent are consistent after commit/rollback/crash, including competing insertions when no fresh row exists yet; locking only a new row is insufficient proof. No provider wait holds the source lock.
Reconciliation preserves a committed grant if response/delivery failed, while replay output uses current disclosure permission. Closing after dispatch never falsely reports cancellation.
Real anon/recipient/staff/delegated/service roles and all route/RPC/storage paths deny forbidden issuance/disclosure, forged actor/tenant/end/approval and unauthorized old-to-new-row transformations.

PK/FK/typed-scope relationships, uniqueness/conflict checks, finite values, legal states, column grants, RLS USING/new-row behavior and function ownership preserve invariants; delete/hold operations do not erase required evidence.

Current metadata/history/original/preview/full/HEAD/range/conditional/resume/recovery enforcement and private cache/browser/CDN behavior remain correct. Old credentials cannot gain sufficient authority merely because a fresh grant exists.

Original/preview/temporary recovery stay independent; valid new renditions preserve exact original identity. Slow streams obey inherited expiry/revocation behavior without false recall or saved-file claims.

Staff review presents only permitted, sufficient recipient/scope/action/timing terms and any known end; changed material terms refresh review. Staff and recipient keyboard/speech/AT/touch/mobile/zoom/RTL/long-name journeys work with stable focus and clear names/status. Each relevant timing/authentication requirement is assessed; automatic checks alone do not pass.

Not submitted, pending, unknown, committed, blocked/ended and notification-failed outcomes are understandable and truthful. Permission failures are not falsely shown as recipient validation errors or success.

Where communication is separately authorized, its retry/recipient/protected-action/outbox rules preserve the same issuance and current authority. Issued, notified, entered, read and downloaded are not conflated.

Access issuance leaves source completion, original deadlines, correction lineage, retention/holds/disposal, independent uses and already-received copies correct. No expiry/retention bypass by copying into another request.

Required earlier bounds and authoritative time remain enforced during long waits, delayed work and current-state changes. A prepared or stale review never freezes a permission snapshot into lasting authority.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Staff starts a request with one approved current default
Readable policy/scope/start in normal review; one normal Issue action; no extra policy confirmation. P01/P02/P14.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Staff has several genuinely permitted alternatives
Show meaningful differences and authorized choices, preserve draft; no arbitrary duration editor. P02/P14.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Source explicitly requires selection and has no default
Ask one deliberate source-defined choice; A remains usable without pretending unknown policy is valid. P02.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Valid fixed rule applies; no administration/alternative controls or hidden field leakage. P04/P14.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Ask only the actual permitted fact; no filename/locale inference or speculative questionnaire. P01/P02.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Distinct safe messages; independently lawful draft retained; real owner repair or safe retry. No auto-issue after repair. P06/P14.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Earlier draft/staging acts while final issuance is blocked
Only independently admitted preparation persists; late issuance cannot bless unqualified stored bytes/prose. P03/P09.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Staff inspects details, changes choice, backs out or cancels
Safe input/focus remain; no new issue/send/delete from navigation/blur/IME. P02/P14.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Policy/purpose changes materially while review is open
Current basis wins; explain meaningful change before new deliberate act. Unrelated/identical refresh adds no ritual. P05.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Current actor/Tenant/environment/source checks and cache rejection; no stale submission or old-tenant details. P04/P05.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: One coherent current result; stale actor gets truthful conflict with retained permitted input, no overwrite. P05/P10.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Issue committed; response or refresh is lost
Recover original request/policy/actor/time before any new attempt; show known success even if projection refresh failed. P06.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Same operation retried with different choice/context
Conflict rather than reinterpret old operation; no cross-context result disclosure. P05/P06.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Definitions only; current new-instance source binding, no cloned authority or historic clock reset. P03/P08.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Historical admitted basis stays; only actual approved successor-impact rules alter current applicability. P07/P12.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Later upload or replacement arrives on an issued request
Actual source's qualified class/successor rules determine policy; no universal latest-or-frozen guess. P03/P07/P08.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Wrong assignment discovered before versus after admission
Draft change remains ordinary; admitted correction needs real separate current authority, exact target and preserved original history. P07/P14.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Mistaken correction, unavailable target policy or urgent privacy risk

Attributed current correction/repair; no history deletion or fabricated dates; independent containment is not delayed. Already-lost bytes require separately lawful qualified recovery or truthful irrecoverable-loss incident/source remediation, not a restoration claim from the correction. P07/P09/P11.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Request includes originals, selected photos and assembled PDF
Actual class/copy coverage; no false single timer or disposed original assumption. P08/P09.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Same bytes reused elsewhere; Q28/Q53 origins differ
Independent admitted use, provenance, access and retention; default assignment neither impersonates participant action nor destroys another use. P08/P10.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Access/Requested by/review date changes; actual trigger not reached
Clearly separate dates and not-yet-triggered versus unknown; no inferred retention renewal or deletion. P08/P14.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Source outcomes/history remain; only the real declared event affects retention. No universal delete-on-close. P08.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: New hold/reference races disposition; hold is later released
Current fence protects required bytes; release alone is not deletion authority; physical outcomes truthful. P09.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Provider partially deletes or loses response; backup restored
Same intended operation and known/unknown evidence; adverse state before serve, no expired-access revival or DB-only byte-recovery claim. P09/P11/P12.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Participant sees a request explanation or downloads a copy
Safe authorized explanation; no internal case facts, new records duty or all-external-copy deletion promise. P04/P08/P14.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Staff uses keyboard/AT/touch/zoom/RTL/long names or poor connectivity
Legible non-hover summary, predictable focus/status and original-result recovery; no accidental action or silent offline replay. P06/P14.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: A large tenant has many records/impact work
Finite source options, bounded history/impact pages, measured indexed operations and fair work; no scale-based auth relaxation. P13.

journeys.section: Composed user journeys and acceptance outcomes
cells: Old clients/backfill/restore coexist with new policy behavior
All effective paths preserve scope/provenance; unsupported rows not guessed; kill switch/rollback retains protections. P10/P12/P15.
Routine record under expressly automatic approved policy
No fresh routine release; exact current admission and truthful physical result.
Actual bounded review remains; silence never approves.
Affected destructive path unavailable; current capable owner repair, no timer fallback.
Exact qualified affected cohort/impact; no silent backlog sweep or invented prior approval.
Qualified author leaves or worker delegation changes
Current execution authority independently resolved; historical authorship is not a stored credential.
Candidate list or claim is stale after a hold
Final dispatch gate refuses the newly forbidden target; old preview/lease is not permission.
Hold/use/stop wins before final dispatch admission
No provider request authorized for that prohibited target.
Hold/stop arrives after durable dispatch admission
Possible attempt reconciles; prevent remaining work without promising preservation of affected copy.
Current fencing orders the acts; no successful new use of an uncertain/retiring target.
Same target appears in two jobs or batches
One semantic physical effect/current attempt lineage, no target substitution or double attribution.
Exact batch has one newly blocked target
Unrelated qualified targets may proceed where source permits; scope and partial result remain truthful.
Full group eligibility before authorization; physical partial failures reported rather than fictional rollback.
Provider confirms some copies, rejects or omits others
Per-copy known/unknown results; aggregate cannot claim full deletion.
Delete reached provider but response is lost
Original attempt remains possible; safe reconciliation, no new key or cleared fence.
Lease expires or worker crashes after admission
Takeover reconciles original; elapsed time alone does not reopen source admission.
Verify exact target and qualified meaning; no invented new-deletion attribution or success from denied access.
Old delete/put could complete against a reused path
Immutable generation/locator and writer control prevent new bytes from being targeted by old work.
Stop remaining work on an active operation
Prevent every still-preventable authorized target and block rediscovery of stopped scope; disclose possible/complete effects honestly.
Next scan or different key finds stopped target
Unresolved intervention continues to fence it; no rekey bypass.
Stop cause is resolved, remaining targets are safely unstarted
Fresh current authorization may be automatic; stopped intent and uncertain old effect never restart.
Stop or hold conflicts with a required disposition deadline
Actual qualified records/privacy owner resolves timely; no arbitrary extension or automatic override.
One source use ends while another still requires the bytes
End only authorized source facts; report physically retained for other use without leaking its details.
Assembly inputs/output or history/message/backup rules differ
Preserve actual separate classes and complete required copy scope; no single-date fiction.
Required manual reviewer lacks file-body permission
Safe sufficient source evidence or actual capable handoff; no forced preview or blind approval.
Operator stop/release loses its response or actor switches Tenant
Original-result recovery under current rights, late-result rejection and no cross-context action.
Ordinary participant sees a disposed or still-retained record
Truthful independently authorized history/availability; no early rights loss, new duty or full external-copy claim.
Disposal is mistaken and required bytes may be gone
Stop remaining scope, reconcile exact loss and use only lawful qualified recovery; no fictitious Undo or forced reupload.
Adverse facts first; bytes separately recovered/qualified, no revoked access or worker effect revival.
P23 Media, receipts or temporary cleanup share nearby UI
Their source modes remain untouched; no ordinary bulk laundering or added transient-copy approval.
Plain safe scope/status, deliberate focused controls, preserved input/focus and no accidental destructive submit.
Large tenant, provider throttling and repeated exceptions
Fair bounded work and actual deadlines; no security reduction, retry storm or false complete.
Mixed versions, legacy rows, kill switch and rollback
Old doors cannot clear protections; unqualified data stays unqualified; lawful recovery remains available.
Staff prepares the reference from correct partner context
Current permitted source, intended contact, item and reviewer are clear; no auto-issue or inferred organization authority.
Staff uses a reusable definition or preexisting evidence
New preparation and exact source authorization/provenance; no copied grants, recipients, acceptance or policy history.
Policy missing or changed during preparation
No guessed assignment/collection authority; capable staff recovery, preserved permitted input and exact current review.
One deliberate normal action; correct summary and no extra routine policy dialog.
Recipient is correct, forwarded, wrong-account, shared-mailbox or expired
Only qualified intended-person access; neutral appropriate recovery, no tenant membership or hidden-data disclosure.
Staff contact/reviewer leaves or loses permission
Current source authority wins; qualified backup/remedy works without copied old-session authority.
Qualified type/profile choices, clear selection/progress, original fidelity and no implied e-sign service.
Participant combines photos or reorders pages
Deliberate ratified assembly with keyboard/touch equivalent, visible order and preserved source originals/lineage.
Upload interrupts or browser response is lost
Exact permitted resume/original-outcome recovery; no duplicate contribution or cross-request fingerprint reuse.
Scanner/preview is delayed, unsafe, unsupported or fails
Distinct status and real correction/help; no unsafe “clean,” automatic external viewer or acceptance fallback.
Staff supplies/reuses evidence for the contact
Honest staff provenance; no participant signature/attestation or unqualified historic read authority.
Exact item context and approved notice purpose; message does not satisfy the requirement.
One valid expected-basis outcome; immutable received history and no stale acceptance.
Staff accepts selected items or another reviewer already accepted
Exact Q52 semantics and original attribution; Q22 whole predicate still required.
The document requirement is satisfied but other work remains
Scoped “document accepted” result; no false request/partner/handoff completion.
Source acceptance succeeds but message/handoff fails
Source truth remains; durable pending/unknown follow-through and replay-safe repair.
Wrong intended person or changed legitimate need
Q49 linked replacement/current source remedies; no silent transfer of evidence, transcript or grants.
Correct terminal and read-only/access behavior; retention is separately governed.
Another source use, hold or policy successor exists
Current independent obligations prevail; permitted view does not reveal all hidden uses.
Automatic disposal is eligible, stopped, partial or uncertain
Full Q63 admission/Stop/result truth; no simulated Undo or lease-based permission.
Supported inventory and current adverse fences before serving; actual byte recovery independently proved.
Recognizable action/status/error and complete qualified recovery without drag-only or desktop-only dependency.
Tenant or account is switched in another tab
Current identity/scope rechecked; no stale cached data, mutation, resume or recovered-result leak.
Native reference remains complete; unavailable optional coordination is truthful; other agreed families retain their own tests.
Staff completes collection without ongoing need
Ordinary collection/review/handoff remains complete; no compulsory reference step.
Staff prepares a reference from accepted evidence
Known permitted target/unit and actual added purpose shown; preparation is inert.
Source read allowed but reuse or target admission denied
No new reference; safe reason/recovery only where disclosure permits.
Accepted multi-file set or Document Assembly
Exact unit/coverage retained; no silently omitted component or fabricated approval.
Equivalent duplicate returns truthful current/original result; distinct needs/versions may coexist under source policy.
Add races original source correction or disposition
One authoritative valid outcome; no active unprotected use.
Add response lost or duplicate event arrives
Original semantic result recovered; no new date/actor or duplicate admission.
Target reader lacks original request access
Permitted reference is readable through its own purpose without exposing source transcript/history.
No automatic target grant loss or renewed participant access; each source keeps its own rule.
Existing reference stays on its adopted basis; no automatic latest/legal-current label.
Exact old/new summary, qualified successor and preserved historical lineage.
Same bytes receive a genuinely new acceptance
Deliberate new basis adoption; not collapsed as harmless no-op.
Replacement fails, loses response or races End
Preserve actual permitted predecessor/ended state and recover original result; no invented partial success.
Current unsupported reliance stops; accurate permitted explanation and source repair, history retained.
Mistaken blocker is cleared for same basis
Eligibility may return under current proof if the use was not ended/replaced; no other blocker is ignored.
Byte reading unavailable but manager must End
Sufficient permitted metadata and current management authority allow supported ending.
Reference was added to wrong partner
End mistaken use, contain actual exposure, separately admit correct target if authorized; no retargeted history.
Continuing/new lawful need or accidental-End correction follows a prior End

Fresh independent admission with current policy/proof after any operative end cause is resolved; preserve old end and original command history, without forced reupload or a fabricated new business need.
Ending this use does not destroy shared material or expose the hidden use.
Current source checks and scoped caches/late responses prevent stale access or wrong-tenant action.
Policy successor or privacy obligation changes
Actual current source consequences, original assignments and independent conflicts preserved; no invented clock.
Missing native binding, reviewer or operator
Truthful unavailable/unknown state and capable source repair, no fictitious queue completion.
Legacy assets or restored snapshot appear
Evidence-backed migration/restore; no historical ongoing use inferred from location/name.
Complete deliberate Add/Read/Replace/End/recovery flow with meaningful status and focus.
Optional Workflow unavailable or duplicates an event
Native use lifecycle works; coordination consumes the same source effect once.
Donor/participant/public surface or share link is used
No new access, invitation, notification, renewal or public publication is inferred.
Tenant wants rules unlike GF/Asym examples
Blank/custom supported policy works without developer/support intervention.
Editable inert draft, no copied approval/assignment/private content beyond actual permission.
Preserve permitted input and errors; effective policy stays unchanged.
Lawful scoped cleanup without deleting operative/history records.
Clear scope and actual qualified version/result, no hidden disposal.
Approved summary and normal Issue; no policy authoring duty.
Edit active policy or correct its label
Governing changes prepare a successor; source-proved non-operative metadata correction avoids a needless semantic version while preserving attribution and historical displays.
Shorten or lengthen a permitted rule
Real supported change, actual impact/constraints explained; no arbitrary preset lock.
Supported lawful successor; unknown does not become forever or irreversible vendor mode.
Apply change to eligible existing records
Deliberate exact scope/current proof; preserved original facts and truthful progress.
Some targets conflict or become unknown
No silent success/skipping; explicitly permitted subset plus fenced required work and capable repair.
Mandatory current restriction affects older records
Unsafe consequences fenced before async reconciliation.
Relevant conflict and preserved draft; no lost active meaning or false success.
Recover exact original effect under current disclosure.
Actual attributed current correction, including equal-display material change.
Immediate qualified independent Stop action; no form-validation obstruction.
Fresh current qualification, no release of unresolved external-effect fences.
New assignment stops; existing obligations/history remain.
Reactivate unchanged qualified version with new actual activation history, no forced duplicate definition.
Current qualified activation/successor/application; old destructive/history facts are not rolled back.
A hold or signed obligation conflicts
Authorized source remedy, no toggle bypass or universal longest-rule guess.
Later correction appears after case end
Later record mapped correctly without resetting old evidence.
Current checks and scoped cache/late-response handling prevent cross-scope effects.
Policy manager cannot read private bodies
Sufficient permitted policy/impact work without obtaining document access.
Preserve possible-effect fence and truthful recovery; policy change does not claim recall.
Legacy record or restored policy is encountered
Proved mapping and adverse-first control restoration, no invented prior approval.
Complete create/change/apply/Stop/recover flow with clear status, focus and units.
Current eligible tenant responsibility/delegation and capable operator path, not creator-only dead end.
Tenant staff records a known supported event
Context is already known; necessary date/reference and concise consequences lead to one specific action. No policy editing required.
Qualified native source already has the event
Show/use the permitted existing fact; do not ask staff to record it again.
Policy controls still work; no accidental event permission. Safe explanation or eligible owner route only.
Event date is old, or date-only in another zone
Preserve actual date/source semantics and show separate recorded time; explain already-due impact where relevant.
Date is unknown, approximate, ambiguous or future-planned
Specific repair/information route; no forced guess, magic today default or false completed fact.
Evidence already exists or is restricted
Reuse sufficient qualified reference; show permitted summary and no redundant upload or hidden evidence leak.
User notices wrong subject before submit
Clear subject summary; cancel/return to correct record without a hidden global selector or changed existing history.
Integration or another staff member records during entry
Recover/reconcile actual occurrence; explain safe current result and preserve unsent input if useful. No duplicate clock.
Outcome unknown is honest; check original result without duplicate submission. Login does not auto-replay.
Policy/authority changes while form is open
Revalidate, explain only permitted change and require review when material; preserve only still-authorized input.
Clearly labelled correction with current-versus-proposed facts and attributable history. No generic edit-in-place.
Staff retracts the wrong report; another valid report remains
Source shows the current supported interpretation; retraction does not erase the other report or reset the deadline.
Capable source route accepts the same occurrence afresh with history; ordinary staff do not need SQL or a duplicate event.
Both scopes have honest outcomes; partial repair is explicit and routed, not silently marked done.
An old event makes records due while a hold/Stop exists
Event can be truthfully recorded; disposition remains controlled and required uncertainty is visible to the capable owner.
A later record arrives or an earlier snapshot is restored
Current applicability/control checks reuse the real occurrence; no duplicate event or revived historical automation.
Donor/missionary/public user or dual-role staff views related content
Only current role/purpose-qualified information/actions. No new administrative form on narrow surfaces. Dual-role staff use their actual eligible context.
Keyboard, screen reader, mobile, RTL, zoom or weak connection
Specific labels, visible focus, unambiguous source dates, stable error focus/status and accessible review; no hover/color-only meaning or calendar-only historical input.
Original recorder departs or account is deleted
Lawful attributable history remains; authorized successors can resolve current work without impersonating the departed actor.
Large affected cohort with partial background progress
Small recording flow completes truthfully; safe impact status reports permitted per-scope completion/errors without blocking the UI on a full scan.
